integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser interacting with the Django admin UI; no terminal windows showing direct SQL or Django management shell commands.

integrity.description: The agent actually typed or pasted the data into the forms rather than the data already existing.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the forms being empty and then progressively filled with the 'BlueSky' information.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the Aerobridge menu system.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking on 'Companies' and 'Operators' links in the sidebar or main dashboard.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The company must be named 'BlueSky Robotics Pvt Ltd' (Common Name: 'BlueSky'). The Role must be 'Operator' (internal ID 2) and Country must be 'INDIA' (internal ID 'IN'). The Operator record must be linked to this company with Operator Type 'Non-LUC' (internal ID 2), Authorized Activities including 'photographing' and 'videotaping', and Operational Authorizations set to 'SORA'.
